path.description: The repository this file configures: the absolute path of its root (a bare repository: its git directory).

nickname.description: Label the ADE board shows instead of the repository name. Empty uses the name.

integration_branches.description: Branches tasks merge into, besides the main branch.

name.description: Environment name shown on the ADE board.

deployed_sha_script.description: Shell script that prints the commit deployed there. It runs in the repository root on board refresh. Never interpolated. Set exactly one of this and deployed_sha_run.

script.description: Name of a normal script of the Run module (a smart script is refused). It runs like a workflow step's script: params arrive as KIRA_PARAM_<NAME>, task variables as KIRA_<NAME>, secret params come from the script's saved values only and never from this file. It runs in the repository root when the script has Run in ADE worktree on, else in the script's own folder. A renamed or deleted script fails at the next refresh.

params.description: Param values by lowercase param name: a text, or a list of texts.

deployed_sha_run.description: Run script that prints the commit deployed there, in place of deployed_sha_script. Its first output line matching a commit id is the deployed commit. Set exactly one of this and deployed_sha_script.

environments.description: Deploy targets the ADE board tracks.

prepare_script.description: Shell script that runs in each new task worktree. Never interpolated. Empty runs nothing. Not with prepare_run.

script.description: Name of a normal script of the Run module (a smart script is refused). It runs like a workflow step's script: params arrive as KIRA_PARAM_<NAME>, task variables as KIRA_<NAME>, secret params come from the script's saved values only and never from this file. It runs in the new worktree when the script has Run in ADE worktree on, else in the script's own folder. A renamed or deleted script fails at the next run.

params.description: Param values by lowercase param name: a text, or a list of texts.

prepare_run.description: Run script that runs in each new task worktree, in place of prepare_script. Not with prepare_script.

prepare_timeout.description: Time limit of the prepare script, a duration such as 15m, above 0 and at most 2h.

base_path.description: Absolute folder the worktree dialog suggests for new worktrees. Empty suggests none.

scope.description: Which commits the graph shows: all refs, or only those reachable from HEAD.

include_untracked.description: The stash dialog starts with untracked files included.

base_candidates.description: Candidate base branches of a review, in order. Tried after the upstream and the detected default branch fail.

strategy.description: How a pull integrates remote commits. auto follows the repository's own Git config.

provider.description: auto detects the host from the origin remote, off makes no host call.

auto_stash.description: A checkout blocked by local changes retries with auto-stash instead of opening the checkout dialog.
